description: Obtaining Membership of the AIA Group Supervisory College by the Insurance Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka (IRCSL)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-18 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - As one step of the Action Plan to improve the effectiveness of Anti Money Laundering/Countering the Financing of Terrorism (AML/CFT) requirement, action has to be taken by the Insurance Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka to establish a mechanism to share information with foreign counterparts. Accordingly, the IRCSL has planned to obtain the membership of the AIA Group Supervisory College, which is headed by the Insurance Authority of Hong Kong and established to ensure effective cooperation and coordination among insurance supervisory authorities in the Asian region. In order to obtain the said membership, the IRCSL is required to enter into a Coordination Agreement with the Insurance Authority of Hong Kong. The said Agreement will enable the IRCSL to effectively exchange supervisory information with other insurance regulatory/supervisory bodies that have obtained the signatory status of the AIA Group Supervisory College. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development for the Insurance Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka to enter into a Coordination Agreement with the Insurance Authority of Hong Kong to obtain the membership of the AIA Group Supervisory College, was approved by the Cabinet.
